**Production change — `src/components/MapContainer.ts` (setCenter buffering / pending-camera replay): correct.**
- The early-`setCenter` buffering, validation, and replay logic is sound. I specifically checked the SVG-fallback handoff race: `initSvgMap()` sets `useDeckGL = false` at `MapContainer.ts:150` *before* calling `replayPendingCenter()` at `:158`, so a camera buffered while `useDeckGL` was `true` (deck attempt) still replays to the SVG delegate after fallback. `replayPendingCenter()` reads current `useDeckGL`, making the cross-delegate handoff correct in all three init paths (pure-SVG, deck-success, deck-fail→SVG).
- Invalid-coordinate guard (`isValidCenter`, `:257`) rejects NaN/±Infinity/out-of-range without discarding the last valid pending camera. Non-finite `zoom` is dropped safely via the `&& { zoom }` spread short-circuit (spreading `false` is a no-op — no crash). `destroy()` clears `pendingCenter` (`:972`). No mutation of `initialState` (spread returns a fresh object). All four behaviors have matching assertions in the new unit test.

**Test changes — legitimate strengthening, not weakening:**
